title: DR Transcript
description: Diminishing-returns scoring session transcript. Records the full reasoning chain for a decision-quality attestation.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be '0.1' for this schema.

session_id.description: Identifier for the work session this transcript belongs to.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the transcript was produced.

agent.description: Identifier of the agent or human that produced the transcript (e.g. 'rowan', 'campion', 'talos').

context_ref.description: Optional reference to the work item this transcript evaluates (e.g. a GitHub issue URL or PR URL).

rounds.description: Ordered list of evaluation rounds. Each round applies the DR scoring formula.

round_number.description: 1-based index of this round within the session.

hypothesis.description: The claim or decision being evaluated in this round.

evidence.description: Evidence items considered in this round.

source.description: Optional URL or citation for the evidence source.

weight.description: Relative importance assigned to this evidence item (0–1).

dr_score.description: Diminishing-returns score for this round (0 = no new signal, 1 = maximum new signal).

novelty_rate.description: Fraction of evidence in this round that was novel vs. previously seen.

agent_notes.description: Optional free-text notes from the evaluating agent for this round.

total_rounds.description: Total number of evaluation rounds completed.

final_score.description: Aggregate DR score across all rounds (diminishing-returns weighted sum).

signal.description: Decision signal emitted by the DR engine: SHIP = proceed, CONTINUE = more work needed, ESCALATE = human review required, BLOCK = do not proceed.

readiness.description: Overall readiness score (0 = not ready, 1 = fully ready).

novelty_rate.description: Average novelty rate across all rounds.

enforcement_level.description: Enforcement level in effect at session close.

stop_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the DR session terminated.
